posts.zh:
dsh-voice-chat 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。语音对话：🎤 语音输入（Web Speech，实时中间结果可编辑）+ 🔊 自动/手动朗读回复（TTS），支持人声/语速/语调设置与识别语言（普通话/粤语等），纯客户端零密钥，朗读前自动清理 Markdown 标记。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3913ba59d3489269b59f.html
posts.en:
dsh-voice-chat is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Voice chat: 🎤 speech input (Web Speech, live editable interim results) plus 🔊 automatic/manual read-aloud replies (TTS), with voice, speed, pitch and recognition-language settings (Mandarin/Cantonese, etc.); fully client-side with zero keys, and Markdown is stripped before reading.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3913ba59d3489269b59f.html
